findings: One new module, two re-exports. EditorActionKind is a closed 10-variant enum covering canvas dispatch surface. NodeKind mirrors workflow.node_kind DDL from P07 phase-spec so kernel and DB share one canonical closed-set.
is_topology_mutation and is_reversible helper predicates encode invariants at the type level without adding any external dep.
is_topology_mutation covers AddNode/RemoveNode/ConnectNodes/DisconnectNodes only — MoveNode, Undo, Redo, OpenProperties, SaveDraft, Publish excluded correctly.
is_reversible adds MoveNode to the topology-mutation set — consistent with undo/redo semantics.
NodeKind::requires_human matches Approval only; introduces_delay matches Timer only — both minimal and precise.
Module name editor_action — singular noun form consistent with existing kernel module naming.
EditorActionKind + NodeKind names match P07 DDL enum identifiers (node_kind -> NodeKind, action type -> EditorActionKind).
Module added to existing crate; lib.rs re-export pattern matches PR #60..#106 cascade pattern.
No new workspace member; Cargo.toml workspace untouched.
Kernel takes no UI/WASM/serde deps — canvas SDK (oya-workflow-leptos-canvas) will depend inward on these types per ADR-0023.

architect.rationale: Smallest meaningful delta from M07-P07 plan. NodeKind mirrors P07 DDL exactly, ensuring kernel-DB alignment from day one without a DB dep. EditorActionKind closes the canvas dispatch surface.

critic.rationale: 10 and 8 variant closed enums with helper predicates. 6 new tests cover all predicate branches. No serde, no workspace deps, no new crate scaffold — strictly merge-variant.
